title: Best free AI reviewer apps for Filipino students
summary: Start free with a short lecture you know well.
body_markdown:
Start with Knowt if your priority is free practice on flashcards, and NotebookLM if you need help finding your way through assigned readings. The best free reviewer for a Filipino student is the one that lets you finish the part of studying you find hardest on an ordinary school day.


Educato publishes this comparison. We include our own reviewer and describe its limits for free study.


## What is the best free AI study app for Filipino students?


Knowt is a sensible first pick for a student who already has questions and wants to keep answering them. Its public Learn Mode page lists free practice tests and spaced repetition with cards you create or import. That matters if you already know what the lesson means but keep forgetting the terms when the handout is closed.[Knowt documentation, checked 2026-11-27](https://knowt.com/learn-mode) .


NotebookLM makes more sense if you sit down with a reading and immediately need to ask what a paragraph means. Google documents a personal Gmail allowance of 100 notebooks with up to 50 sources per notebook. Those are storage and organization limits. They tell you something about fitting your subjects into an account, but they do not tell you how many useful questions a particular reading will yield.[Notebooklm documentation, checked 2026-11-27](https://support.google.com/gemininotebook/answer/16213268?hl=en) .

## What does free actually cover on a school day?


Follow the activity from beginning to end. Imagine importing a Filipino class handout over campus Wi-Fi, answering questions after class, then returning to the ones you missed before breakfast. An import allowance matters during the first part. A limit on answering or repeating questions matters during the last part. A plan that works for a student who builds cards on Sundays can be frustrating for someone whose lecturer posts corrections every afternoon.


Gizmo illustrates the difference. Its free account permits unlimited cards and decks, while Memorise uses hearts and Magic Import has a wait between imports. If you want to add a whole pile of separate handouts during a break, that wait is relevant. If you write a deck yourself and practise a little at a time, another limit may matter more.[Gizmo documentation, checked 2026-11-27](https://help.gizmo.ai/en/articles/15647627-what-do-i-get-with-gizmo-unlimited) .


Quizlet's free account includes flashcards, practice questions, diagrams and activities. That makes it worth opening if your classmates already study an accurate set together. Ask which mode they actually use. Seeing a particular action in a friend's subscription tells you little about whether your own account includes the same practice session.[Quizlet documentation, checked 2026-11-27](https://help.quizlet.com/hc/en-ca/articles/360041181691-Subscribing-to-Quizlet) .


## How would you compare the answers in English and Filipino?


Give each candidate the same small piece of writing that you own. For example, imagine your research methods note says, “In this class poll, respondents could choose more than one language.” Your question is whether the number of language selections must equal the number of respondents. The answer is no. A single respondent can contribute several selections. There is enough information in that note to explain the answer without guessing anyone's language.


Now try the question aloud as you might hear it in class. “Kapag pinagsama ang mga sagot, bilang na ba iyon ng mga estudyante?” An answer that merely translates “respondents” misses the point about multiple selections. Give credit to a card that makes you explain the counting rule. Reject one that assumes each student picked a single language. Keep the short original note beside your answer key so a smooth translation cannot persuade you to learn a different claim.


One more change makes the exercise useful tomorrow. Ask what would have to change on the survey form for the totals to match, assuming everyone responds. A good answer specifies a single required selection per person. You now have an application question you can ask a friend even if you never open the app again.


## When does a free textbook or paper reviewer win?


Use the assigned textbook when the instructor names a figure, passage or end-of-chapter exercise. Its advantage is a common reference. You and your seatmate can point to the same caption and settle what the exercise asks. Its limitation is that reading the printed answer can feel like knowing it. Cover the explanation, commit to your answer on paper and only then uncover the key.


For an instructor-made quiz, the official course outline and marked sample exercise give you a target for difficulty and wording. An outline may list “interpret survey results” without offering any extra questions. Make your own by changing who answered the poll or how the choices worked. For a recitation, rehearse the explanation out loud. A multiple-choice streak tells you little about whether you can finish the sentence when your instructor asks why.


Educato is best suited here to building practice around a permitted lecture file or photo. Its limit is the quality and scope of that source. A reviewer built from incomplete class notes can leave out an assigned reading entirely. If all you have is a borrowed chapter you cannot upload, keep it open on your desk and write questions in your own words.


## What should you keep before switching apps?


Keep a plain copy of the questions you have corrected yourself. Mark the lecture title next to each disputed answer. If a free allowance interrupts you, finish from that copy on paper. This also lets you compare two tools fairly. Each gets the same prompts and the same opportunity to handle your difficult material, even if one makes a much prettier summary.


Use a handout you are allowed to share with a service. The Philippine education-sector advisory identifies educational information as sensitive personal information. A screenshot of a class poll can include classmates' names or grades in the margins. Recreate the anonymous counting example in a fresh document instead of uploading the class results.[Philippine education-sector advisory, checked 2026-11-27](https://www.privacy.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/DP-Council-Education-Sector-Advisory-No.-2020-1.pdf) .


Make the final choice after trying the part you would repeat each week. If the hardest moment was remembering the rule, keep the free card routine. If it was finding the line that established the rule, keep the source notebook. If discussing the sample with a classmate solved both problems, your handwritten answer key has already done the job.
